https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.description:
A replacement kit for Bear Traps which changes the usual dual spring system to four coil springs, adding a great amount of strength to the Bear Traps hold.
• Increases the Disarm time of the Bear Trap by +33 %.
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.name: 4-Coil Spring Kit

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.description:
Unlocks a special ability for the Fire Axe:
• The Fire Axe can travel through Security Doors and will exit straight through the connected Security Door.
While aiming the Fire Axe, you benefit from the following effect:
• Survivors within 6 metres of any Security Door trigger Killer Instinct.
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.flavor: "Gaining control over the security doors is key to getting the job done."
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.name: Access Panel

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.description:
Whenever an Exit Gate is opened, Alucard's Shield triggers its effect:
• Causes the area inside the Exit Gate to continuously spawn Pillars of Flame.
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.flavor: "A family heirloom that blocks its bearer's enemies at every turn.""Oh, but this world invited me. Your own kind called me forth with praise and tribute." — Dracula
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.name: Alucard's Shield

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.description:
Survivors opening a Treasure Chest suffer from the following effects:
• Inflicts the Oblivious Status Effect for 15 seconds.
• At least 2 Treasure Chests in the environment will roll a 1 on their Dice Roll.
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.flavor: "The realm itself bends to its astounding capacity, populating trials with even more to take."
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.name: Bag of Holding

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.description:
Modifies Worldbreaker with the following effect:
• The second phase of the Worldbreaker Timer is increased by 2.5 seconds for each living Survivor.
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.flavor: "A developmental toy used to enrich the minds of captive children."
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.name: Bead Maze

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.description:
Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability while using The Upside Down in Worldbreaker Mode:
• The Aura of the furthest survivor more than 36 meters is revealed to you for 3 seconds.
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.flavor: "A terrifying spider that is no longer a mere hallucination."
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.name: Black Widow Spider

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.description:
Modifies the Scent Orbs with the following effect:
• Extends their Lifetime by +60 %.
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.flavor: "The blood of his victims sustains him and makes him an even greater hunter."
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.name: Blood-Filled Goblet

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.description:
Modifies the Undergate Attack with the following effect:
• Grants the 20 % Haste Status Effect for 1.5 seconds.
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.flavor: "A memento of the fury that Eleven was capable of."
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.name: Bloody Roller Skate

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.description:
Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability while moving between Security Doors:
• The intensity of the Generator Auras reveals their current Repair progress.
Upon exiting a Security Door after teleporting to it, the following effect applies:
• Reduces the duration of the Undetectable Status Effect by -100 % to 0 seconds.
• This causes the Status Effect to be removed instantly.
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.flavor: "Worn strings that are off-tune and liable to snap."
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.name: Bonnie's Guitar Strings

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.description:
After casting the Mage Hand Spell, you benefit from the following effect:
• Grants a +3 % Haste Status Effect for 2 seconds.
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.flavor: "A simple click of their heels grants their wearer incredible pace."
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.name: Boots of Speed

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.description:
Modifies Worldbreaker with the following effect:
When Worldbreaker Mode activates, the following effects trigger for 65 seconds
• Increases vaulting speed by 30 %.
• Pallet and Window auras are revealed within 32 metres
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.flavor: "A cool way to get around, smashed by a furious brother as a means of control."
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.name: Broken Skateboard

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.description:
After embedding the Fire Axe in a Survivor, all Players benefit from the following effects while within 32 metres of that Survivor:
• Grants a +12 % Haste Status Effect.
• Increases the Vaulting speed by +20 %.
Both effects last until the Fire Axe is removed.
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.flavor: "The celebration lasts all night long, or until no one is left."
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.name: Celebrate! Poster

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.description:
Modifies the Scent Orbs with the following effect:
• Increases their Aura-Reveal distance by +100 %.
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.flavor: "A sharp memento from one of Dracula's most terrifying guards."
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.name: Cerberus Talon

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.description:
Modifies the Vine Attack with the following effect:
• Gains two charges, and has it's attack radius reduced by 40 %
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.flavor: "One of the few forms of entertainment while in the facility, it helped the students learn logic and tactics."
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.name: Chess Piece

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.description:
While inside the Area of Effect of the Fire Axe, Survivors suffer from the following effect:
• Inflicts the Exhausted Status Effect.
• This effect lingers for 5 seconds after leaving the Area of Effect.
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.flavor: "A good way to keep Mr Cupcake from making a mess."
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.name: Chica's Bib

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.name: Cloak of Elvenkind

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.description:
Whenever all four Spells are on cool-down at the same time, you benefit from the following effect:

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.name: Cloak of Invisibility

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.description:
Modifies the Grandfather Clocks with the following effect:

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.flavor: "Hands of the Creel family's grandfather clock, corrupted by Henry's dark power."
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.name: Clock Hands

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.description:
Modifies the Shapeshift ability with the following effect:
• Reduces its Cool-down time by -5 %.
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.flavor: "A piece of the great clock tower, a reminder of the inevitability of time itself."
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.name: Clock Tower Gear

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.description:
Whenever the Dispelling Sphere Spell detects a Survivor, you benefit from the following effect:

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.flavor: "Used by spellcasters for centuries to scry upon friend and foe alike."
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.name: Crystal Ball

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.flavor: "A strange box whose presence creates something from nothing."
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.name: Cube of Zoe

Successfully hitting a Survivor equipped with a Magic Item with a Basic Attack triggers the following effect:

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.flavor: "Made from the actual tooth of a dragon, its edge is jagged and cruel."
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.name: Dragontooth Dagger

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.description:
Modifies Worldbreaker with the following effect:
• At the start of the second phase, Survivors more than 26 meters away have their Auras revealed to you for 6 seconds.
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.flavor: "Used to measure the brain's activity. In the lab, nothing goes unnoticed."
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.name: Electrode Cap

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.description:
Modifies The Upside Down with the following effect:
• When exiting, all Vault locations within 32 meters are blocked for 12 seconds.
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.flavor: "A cruelly efficient way of training and punishing the facility's prisoners."
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.name: Electroshock Collar

While inside the Area of Effect of the embedded Fire Axe, you benefit from the following effect:

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.flavor: "Greater computing power, for greater efficacy."
https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.name: Endo CPU

Upon throwing the Fire Axe, the following effects are applied:

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.name: Faz-Coin

Modifies the Scent Orbs with the following effect:

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.name: Force of Echo

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.flavor: "A piece of paper used to prove the death of a powerful person who was very much alive."

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.description:
Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability while using Vine Attack:

While winding up an axe throw, you benefit from the following effect:

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.name: Help Wanted Ad

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.description:
Whenever you use the Fly Spell to pass through a Window, the following effects apply:
• Blocks the Window for all Survivors for 45 seconds.

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.flavor: "The ultimate compilation of cruelty, wickedness and depravity.""What chance do you have against my centuries of preparation?" — Vecna

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.name: Iridescent Remnant

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.description:
Modifies the Hellfire attack with the following effect:
• Causes the Pillars of Flame to home-in on nearby Survivors.

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.name: Iridescent Ring of Vlad

https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/images/Ic.description:
Modifies Worldbreaker with the following effect:
